m: निर्-√ या P. -याति, to go out, come forth, go from (abl.) to or into (acc.), set out for (dat., [e.g. युद्धाय, MBh.; दिग्-जयाय, Rājat.] or अर्थम् [e.g. भिक्षार्थम्, Pañc.]), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (with मृगयाम्) to go hunting, MBh.; to depart from life, die, Car.; to pass away (as time), Kāv.; to weed (a field), MBh. : Caus. -यापयति, to cause to go out &c., MBh.; R.; to drive away, expel from (abl.), BhP.
निर्-˚या f. getting out of order, disturbance, defect (esp. of a rite), TS.; TāṇḍBr.
a: निर्या — {c2c} P. 1 To go out, go out, of; R. 12. 83. --2 To pass, elapse (as time).

m: निर्-˚याण n. going forth or out, exit, issue
setting out, decamping (of an army), going out (of cattle to the pasture ground), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
departure, vanishing, disappearance, Rājat.; Sāh.
departure from life, death, MBh.; Hariv.; Var.
final emancipation (w.r. for निर्-वाण ?), L.
a road leading out of a town, L.
the outer corner of an elephant's eye, Daś.; Śiś. (cf. निर्-णायन)
a rope for tying cattle, a foot-rope
a: निर्याणं — 1 Exit, issue, setting out, departure. --2 Vanishing, disappearing. --3 Dying, death. --4 Eternal emancipation, final beatitude. --5 The outer corner of the eye of an elephant; वारणं निर्याणभागेऽभिघ्नन् Dk. 97; निर्याणनिर्यदसृजं चलितं निषादी Śi. 5. 41. --6 A rope for tying cattle or the feet of a calf, a foot-rope in general; निर्याणहस्तस्य पुरो दुधुक्षतः Śi. 12. 41. --7 Iron.

k.v: अवग्रहो ललाटं स्यादीषिका त्वक्षिकूटकम्. अपाङ्गदेशो निर्याणं कर्णमूलं तु चूलिका॥

m: निर्-˚याण—हस्त mfn. having a foot-rope in the hand, Śiś. xii, 41.
निर्-˚याणिक mfn. conducive to emancipation, Lalit.
निर्-√ याच् P. Ā. -याचति, ˚ते, to beg of or solicit from (abl.), to ask, entreat, request (with double acc.), AV.; TS.; TāṇḍBr.
निर्—यादव mfn. freed from the Yādavas, Hariv.

s: puM, (niryamyate'neneti । nir + yama + GaY .) potavAhaH । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 540 ॥
m: निर्-याम m. (√ यम्) a sailor, pilot, L. (cf. नि-य्˚).
निर्-˚यामणा f. assistance, ib.
निर्-˚यामक m. an assistant, HPariś.
निर्-˚यापण n. (fr. Caus.) expelling, banishing, BhP.
निर्-˚यापित mfn. caused to go out &c.
removed, destroyed, BhP.
undertaken, begun, ib.

s: puM, (nir + yasa + GaY .) kazAyaH । kvATaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ vfkzAdikzIram । AwA iti BAzA ॥ tatparyyAyaH । vezwakaH 2 । iti ratnamAlA ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 5 । 6 । “lohitAn vfkzaniryAsAn vraScanapraBavAMstaTA । SeluM gavyaYca peyUzaM prayatnena vivarjjayet ॥” ardDarcAditvAt klIve'pi dfSyate ॥ * ॥ kvacit svaraso'pi vAcyaH । yaTA, vEdyakacikitsAsaMgrahe dalIkandaGfte । “kadalIkandaniryAse tatprasUnatulAM pacet । caturBAgAvaSeze'smin GftaprasTaM vipAcayet ॥”)

m: निर्-यास m. (n. g. अर्धर्चादि; √ यस्) exudation of trees or plants, juice, resin, milk (ifc. f(आ). ), Gaut.; Mn.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
any thick fluid substance, Hariv.
extract, decoction, L. (also ˚स्या f., Viṣṇ., Sch.)
a: निर्यासः, --सं — 1 Exudation of trees or plants, gum, juice, resin; शालनिर्यासगंधिभिः R. 1. 38; Ms. 5. 6. --2 Extract, infusion, decoction. --3 Any thick fluid substance.

m: निर्-या˚सिक mfn. g. कुमुदादि on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
निर्-यास्या f., extract, decoction, Viṣṇ., Sch.
निर्-˚यात mfn. gone out or forth, issued, &c.
laid aside (as money), MBh.
completely familiar or conversant with (loc. or comp.), Lalit. (v.l. निर्-जात).

m: निर्-˚यातक mfn. bearing away, carrying off, removing (ifc.; cf. प्रेत-, मृत-).

m: निर्-˚यातन n. giving back, returning, restoring, delivery of a deposit, replacing anything lost, payment of a debt (with gen. or comp.; cf. वैर-), Hariv.; R. &c.
gift, donation, L.
revenge, killing, slaughter, L.
a: निर्यातनं — 1 Returning, restoring, delivering, restitution (as of a deposit). --2 Payment of a debt. --3 Gift, donation. --4 Retaliation, requital, revenge (as in वैरनिर्यातन). --5 Killing, slaughter.

k.v: निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥
निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥
निर्यातनं वैरशुद्धौ दाने न्यासार्पणेऽपि च। व्यसनं विपदि भ्रंशे दोषे कामजकोपजे॥

m: निर्-˚यातृ m. a weeder (of a field), MBh. (cf. निर्दातृ).
निर्-˚याति f. departure, dying, final emancipation, Buddh.
a: निर्यातिः — f. 1 Exit, departure. --2 Departure from life, dying, death.

m: निर्-˚यातित mfn. restored, returned, requited, MBh.; Hariv.
past, spent (as years), R.

v: tri॰ nir + yAti--karmaRi yat । 1 SoDanIye 2 pratideyeca “kanyA cEvaM na cAnyasya niryAtyAnena saNgatA” harivaM॰ 177 a॰ ।
m: 1. निर्-˚यात्य ind. having restored &c., Kathās.
2. निर्-˚यात्य mfn. to be restored or delivered &c., MBh.; Hariv.
निर्—यूथ mfn. separated or strayed from the herd (as an elephant), Hariv.

m: निर्-यूह n. (m., L.; often v.l. and prob. only w.r. for निर्-व्यूह) prominence, projection
a kind of pinnacle or turret, MBh.; Hariv.; R. (ifc. f(आ). )
a helmet, crest or any similar head-ornament, MBh.; Hariv. (= आपीड, L.)
a peg or bracket, L.
wood placed in a wall for doves to build upon, W.
a door, gate, Hariv.
निर्-यूह m. extract, juice, decoction, R.; Suśr. (cf. निर्-यास, निर्-यूष)
a: निर्यूहः — 1 A pinnacle, turret, projection (on columns or gates); वित र्दिनिर्यूहविटंकनीडः Śi. 3. 55 (where Malli. renders निंर्यूह by मत्तवारणाख्यउपाश्रयः and quotes Vaijayantī; perhaps it was so called from its resemblance to the shape of an elephant in rut); चारुतोरणनिर्यूहा Rām. --2 A chaplet, crest, head-ornament. --3 A peg projecting from a wall. --4 Wood placed in a wall for pigeons to build their nests or to perch upon. --5 A door, gate. --6 Extract, decoction.

k.v: दलेऽपि बर्हं निर्बन्धोपरागार्कादयो ग्रहाः। द्वार्यापीडे क्वाथरसे निर्यूहो नागदन्तके॥

दलेऽपि बर्हं निर्बन्धोपरागार्कादयो ग्रहाः। द्वार्यापीडे क्वाथरसे निर्यूहो नागदन्तके॥
दलेऽपि बर्हं निर्बन्धोपरागार्कादयो ग्रहाः। द्वार्यापीडे क्वाथरसे निर्यूहो नागदन्तके॥

m: निर्-यूष m. extract, juice &c. = निर्-यास, L.
निर्—यशस्क mfn. inglorious, MBh.

s: tri, (nir + yantra + lyuw .) abADam । nirargalam । ucCadKalam । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yantraRASUyam । yaTA, suSrute । 1 । 44 । “tataH svAdeduzRatoyasevI niryantraRAstvime ॥”)
v: na॰ nir + yantra--lyuw । 1 nizpIqane nirgat yantraRaM yasmAt prA॰ ba॰ । 2 yantraRASUnye vADASUnye 3 nirargale 4 ucCfNKale tri॰ jawA॰ ।
m: निर्—यन्त्रण mfn. unrestrained, uncontrolled, self-willed, independent, Kāv.; Suśr. (also ˚त्रित, W.)
निर्—यन्त्रणम् ind. without restraint, Ṛtus.; Rājat.
निर्—यन्त्रण—प्रदेशावस्थित mfn. being at a place where no restraint is needed, Kull.
1. निर्-यत् mfn. (निर्-√ इ) going forth, coming out, issuing, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

2. निर्-√ यत् Caus. -यातयति, to snatch away, carry off, take or fetch out of (abl.), get, procure, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv.; to give back, restore, make restitution, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to give as a present, Lalit.; Divyāv.; (वैरम्) to return or show enmity, take revenge, MBh.; R.; Divyāv.; to forgive, pardon, set free, MW.
a: निर्यत् — {c10c} U. 1 To return, restore; निर्यातय हस्तन्यासं V. 5; Ms. 11. 164. --2 To requite, repay, retaliate; रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वैरं स्वयं निर्यातयामि वै Rām. --3 To forgive, pardon.

m: निर्—यत्न mfn. inactive, immovable, lazy, Hariv.
निर्—यत्न—ता f. inactivity, ib.
निर्-√ येष् -येषति, to boil or bubble forth, TS.
निर्-˚यियासु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing or trying to go out, Suśr.
निर्-˚योग m. (prob.) a decoration, Hariv.
a rope for tying cows, BhP., Sch.
निर्—योग-क्षेम mfn. free from care or anxiety about acquisition or possession, Bh. ii, 45.
निर्-योल m. (fr. ?) a partic. part of a plough, Kṛṣis.
निर्-√ 3. यु (only Ā. pres. p. -युवाण mfn.) to keep away, ward off, RV. iv, 48, 2.
निर्-युक्त mfn. (√ युज्) constructed, built, erected, raised, Hariv.
(ifc.) directed towards (v.l. निर्-मुक्त), ib.
(in music) limited as to metre and measure (v.l. नि-य्˚).
1. निर्—युक्ति f. want of union or connection (esp. in gram.)
unfitness, impropriety, W.
निर्—युक्ति mfn. unfounded, illogical, wrong, Gol.
2. निर्-˚युक्ति (for 1. See p. 542, col. 1) f. (with Jainas) explanation of a sacred text (cf. निर्-उक्ति).

m: 1. निर्—युक्˚तिक mfn., L.
1. निर्—युक्˚तिक-त्व n., L.
